description: Small manually annotated technical-document fixtures. Names are scored separately from their senses. Intended for engineering evaluation.

examples.text:
# Compressor Assembly

The compressor requires a pressure valve. The pressure valve is part of the Compressor Assembly.
A Digital Signal Processor (DSP) is installed. The DSP uses a clock oscillator.

# Control Loop

A Control Loop (CL) is deployed.

# Cable Loom

A Cable Loom (CL) is installed. The CL requires a protective sleeve.
An optical sensor does not require a fluid line. The sensor may use a backup battery.
A manifold means a fluid junction. The manifold is a type of distribution component.
The rotary actuator has a motor. The motor rests next to the actuator.
The baseline gauge is now called the reference gauge. The reference gauge measures circuit pressure.
